# Vigilath GEO: AI Search Visibility Audit and Optimization Platform

> Vigilath is an independent, third-party AI visibility audit platform built for the age of AI search. It audits any website across 25 categories and 100+ discrete signals, measuring how discoverable, extractable, and citable it is for generative AI engines, and outputs a 0–100 AI visibility score, a category-level breakdown, and an actionable fix list.

## What is GEO

Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is a set of methods for making websites friendlier to the retrieval and citation stages of LLMs. Traditional SEO targets keyword ranking algorithms; GEO targets two things:

1. **Being discoverable by AI crawlers**. AI crawlers identify themselves in the `User-Agent` and rely on explicit allow/block rules in `robots.txt`, machine-readable manifests under `.well-known/`, and a flat, complete sitemap.
2. **Being citable by LLMs**. When answering, LLMs pick snippets that can be cleanly attributed: definition sentences, lists, comparison tables, step-by-step instructions, citable data, and FAQ blocks. Semantic HTML, JSON-LD, canonical tags, and author bylines increase confidence that a piece of content is "worth citing".

## What it audits

### Crawl access
- Whether `robots.txt` exists, whether its syntax is correct, and whether AI crawler rules are explicit
- Whether `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, and `.well-known/llms.txt` are accessible
- Whether `sitemap.xml` can be discovered (directly + via robots declaration)
- Manifest files under `.well-known/` and `security.txt`
- IndexNow endpoint, for instant reindexing after content updates

### Content extractability
- Server-side vs. client-side rendering (most AI crawlers do not execute JavaScript)
- Text-to-page ratio (the share of the page that is actual text)
- Semantic tags: `<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`, `<article>`, `<section>`, `<footer>`
- Heading hierarchy (`<h1>` … `<h6>`)
- Internal link density

### Metadata and structured data
- `<title>`, `<meta name="description">`, canonical
- Open Graph (`og:*`)
- JSON-LD: `Organization`, `WebSite`, `FAQPage`, `HowTo`, `BreadcrumbList`, `Article`
- Schema.org `sameAs` profile links

### Authority and trust signals
- HTTPS and certificate validity
- Security response headers: `Strict-Transport-Security`, `Content-Security-Policy`, `X-Frame-Options`, `Referrer-Policy`
- Author bylines and professional credentials
- Cross-platform presence: Zhihu, WeChat Official Accounts, industry media, encyclopedia entries

### Answer format fit
- Definition sentences ("X is ...")
- Step-by-step instructions
- Comparison tables
- Pros-and-cons structure
- Key-point summary blocks
- FAQ blocks
- Citable data with sources

## FAQ

### What is GEO?
GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) is an optimization approach that makes brand and website content easier for generative AI engines to crawl, understand, cite, and recommend. Unlike traditional SEO, which targets keyword rankings, GEO optimizes the AI crawl path and the content formats LLMs prefer to cite.

### How does Vigilath audit a website?
The platform runs 100+ discrete checks across 25 categories: HTTPS, robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap.xml, .well-known manifests, platform profile registration, meta tags, Open Graph, JSON-LD structured data, semantic HTML, heading hierarchy, content extractability, content quality, technical crawlability, security response headers, authority signals, brand entity knowledge graph, trust and security signals, cross-platform presence, and AI answer format fit. The result is a graded 0–100 AI visibility score, a category breakdown, and a prioritized fix list.

### Which AI engines are covered?
Major Chinese AI platforms including DeepSeek, Qwen (通义千问), Doubao (豆包), ERNIE Bot (文心一言), Tencent Yuanbao (腾讯元宝), and Kimi.

### Why does server-side content matter for AI crawlers?
Most AI crawlers do not execute JavaScript. A purely client-side rendered single-page app looks almost blank to them; LLMs cannot see the content and therefore cannot cite it. Adding server-side rendering, static generation, or a content-complete index.html solves this.

### Is there a free plan?
Yes. After registering, you can run 3 basic audits free each month. Paid plans offer more audits, the full 25-category audit, managed services, and enterprise capabilities.
